input.summary: P5 hall (x 87..89, z 15..17) furnished in parts/room-40.mjs: newel-post coat stand with a standing lantern (NW), chest dresser (NE), two stair-seat chairs facing the hearth (SW, SE), red carpet runner on the door-to-hearth lane, hanging lantern over the lane. 9 cells placed, no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE, make.sh wrote a whole build.nbt.

waste.what: The room check reported 'no way in' and floating floors because this copy has no shell (y1 floor, walls, y5 ceiling are stubs), so I wrote /tmp/p47-shell-test.mjs to wrap build.nbt in a test floor, ceiling and walls and checked that copy instead.
waste.cost: one extra script and two check runs, about 2 minutes
waste.tool: mcd room should accept the rooms.json box walls or a --shell option, or the room check should ignore the missing shell and say so, so an interior designer can check a room before its shell is merged

waste.what: The coat rack helper needs a banner, which is not in palette.json, so I used a fence post with a standing lantern and built the coat stand by hand.
waste.cost: about 3 cells worked out by hand
waste.tool: a coatRack variant without banner (fence post plus hooks or trapdoors) in vocab h4, using palette blocks only

waste.what: Chair facing and the hearth lane were worked out cell by cell from the floor grid.
waste.cost: a few minutes of reasoning, no retries
waste.tool: mcd plan could mark which cells are the focal line (door to hearth) and which are free lanes, so furniture avoids them automatically

companions.task: Build the coat stand and the stair-seat chairs properly, and check the chair backs and their facings against the hearth wall.

Check the light for the whole house, not just this hall; the hanging lantern needs a ceiling block at y5 from the shell, and the standing lantern could move to a bracket on the wall if the hall is too dim.

left: The hanging lantern at (88,4,16) needs a ceiling block at (88,5,16); the upper floor layer from the shell must cover x 87..89, z 15..17 when the parts are merged.

The hall's floor (y1), walls and ceiling are not in this copy (stubs), so the real room check says 'no way in' and reports floating blocks; with the test shell (floor, ceiling, walls, openings) it says OK: walk 8 of 8, 0 dark cells, min light 12, FIT OK. The test shell is /tmp/p47-shell-test.mjs and the wrapped file is test-room.nbt in this directory; neither is part of the build.
plan.md's checklist has parts 1-6 only, and elements.md's rooms item covers whole houses, so I ticked nothing; I did not edit plan.md to avoid conflicts with the other workers.
room.png was rendered from the test shell (from above); the hearth at z18 is hidden behind the back wall in that view, so the focal line is not visible in the picture.
